findings.title: The pipette draws air from well A1 in slot 2: the liquid is below the tip
findings.explanation: At line 35 the p20_single_gen2 draws 2 ul from sample_1 (well A1 in slot 2) with its tip 1 mm above the bottom of the well. By then the well holds 10 ul, which in this NEST 96 Well Plate 200 µL Flat reaches only 0.31 mm up: the tip is above the liquid and draws air (this line did it 96 times; 192 ul of air in all). The simulator does not notice: it does not follow the liquid. The 96 wells filled from these draws got air instead of liquid. Source wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 88 more in slot 2.
findings.fix: Keep the liquid above the tip. This well needs about 35 ul in it for the surface to reach 1 mm. Load that much more than the run draws; or draw from a smaller vessel (a tube lifts the liquid); or aspirate lower with `well.bottom(0.5)`.
